output.headline: Approves the minutes of the Board's special meeting on December 15, 2025

output.headline: Extends Alder Graduate School of Education residency partnership to 2027; up to $5,450 per resident
output.summary: This amendment extends the district's memorandum of understanding (MOU) with the Alder Graduate School of Education from June 30, 2025 to June 30, 2027. The district's contribution is up to $5,450 per enrollee, for up to 30 residents, with a minimum enrollment of 18. The enrollment commitment for the 2027-2028 residency program is to be confirmed by October 1, 2026, subject to Board approval.

output.summary: The district receives a $250,000 grant to support general operations of its elementary literacy program, The Town Reading Champions, run through the Academics and Instruction Department. The grant period is November 6, 2025 through June 30, 2026.

output.headline: Approves the application to keep state preschool and family literacy funding for 2026-27
output.summary: The Board adopts a resolution approving the district's continued funding application for the California State Preschool Program (CSPP) and the Pre-Kindergarten & Family Literacy Program (CPKS), run by the Early Childhood Education Department. The funding renews automatically for July 1, 2026 through June 30, 2027. The text does not state a dollar amount.

output.headline: Adopts a new board policy on responsible use of artificial intelligence by students and staff
output.summary: The Board adopts new Board Policy 0441 on artificial intelligence (AI), recommended by the Teaching and Learning Committee. It sets guiding principles and governance for the responsible, ethical and secure use of AI by students and staff in the district.

output.headline: Sends release notices to probationary and temporary teachers not being reelected for 2026-27
output.summary: This resolution gives notice of release from their positions to every probationary and temporary certificated (credentialed) employee who will not be reelected for the 2026-2027 school year, under California Education Code Sections 44929.21 and 44954. The text does not list who is affected or give a dollar amount.

output.headline: Approves free Canva graphic design licenses for three years, with a student data privacy agreement
output.summary: Canva USA, Inc. will provide licensing, hosting, upgrades and support for the Canva online graphic design platform at no cost to the district from December 18, 2025 to December 18, 2028. A Standard Student Data Privacy Agreement sets the rules for any student data the district shares with Canva and how Canva must protect it.

The grant period runs from November 13, 2025 through June 30, 2026, and began before this vote.

output.headline: Adds $20,000 and two months to a newcomer cooking and gardening services contract, now up to $52,000
output.summary: The Board ratifies a change to a services agreement with Zachary Reidman of Berkeley, who helps run cooking, gardening and nutrition programs for newcomer refugee youth and adults at Oakland International High School and Rudsdale Newcomer Continuation School. The change adds $20,000, raising the not-to-exceed amount from $32,000 to $52,000, and extends the end date from April 30, 2026 to June 30, 2026. The agreement started August 1, 2025, before this vote.
